title: Stamp
description: SVG-driven stamp generator using uploaded artwork

variants.notes: Stamp plate and SVG artwork only; the handle and template knub are available in the OpenSCAD variant.

parityExclusions.opencascade: The original OCCT variant intentionally models the stamp plate and SVG strokes only; it excludes the SCAD knub/handle STL templates and uses a corrected artwork scale. See main.occt.ts source documentation.
